title: Proof of qbeta delta tau canonical conditional q2 minus 1 factor
html:
Proof of the canonical (q^2-1) factor

By chi_blocks_have_q2_minus_1_factor, each per-block character satisfies \chi_\lambda(q) = (q^2 - 1) P_\lambda(q) for q > 0. Substituting these into the weighted sum and factoring out (q^2 - 1) yields the claim. The Lean proof uses direct substitution and a ring identity. \square

Limitations

  • Concrete instance of CanonicalMarkovWeightsH3. The formalisation of canonical \sqrt q-bearing Wenzl weights requires Markov-parameter \sqrt q handling beyond the ring tactic. This theorem is rigorous conditionally on such an instance existing.
  • Higher-order Taylor coefficients of \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M^{\text{can}}. Vanishing at q = 1 (order-0) is an immediate consequence. Higher orders depend on the specific behaviour of y_\lambda(q) at q = 1, which the dimension-normalisation axiom does not uniquely determine.
  • Bridge to the c_k precision ladder. The f-map itself remains open. What follows provides pre-archimedean structural input for the f-map, rather than completing the derivation.
